quests.title: Life Flows On (I)

dialogue.t: Hello there, Traveler. How have things been?
Has something strange happened again, Katheryne?
Compared to previous major incidents, this one is not the most peculiar. However, it is still quite serious, as it risks having a great impact on Mondstadt's economy.
Recently, the bodies of water near the winery have turned bitter without any warning. If this persists, Mondstadt's wine industry may be wiped out in just a few years.
For more details, please speak with Connor at the winery.
Are you the people sent by the Adventurers' Guild?
That's us!
Well, that's a relief. Now, as for the matter at hand — rather than listening to me explain it, you may as well experience it for yourselves.
This is a bottle of water that we drew just recently. It is hygienic, don't worry — we've put it through its purification paces. Have a taste and see.
Oh, oh, Paimon wants some too, Paimon wants a try!
Ugh! Blergh! It's so bitter...
This bitterness cannot be removed via conventional purification processes, so it's not an issue of the water's composition. I suspect it must be some mysterious elemental phenomenon.
As such, this water can't be used to make wine at all.
That must've been tough for the nearby fish as well, right?
We tried cooking some of the fish killed by the bitter water. All the food we made turned out bitter, too.
Paimon... hadn't quite thought that far.

Anyway, that's the situation. If you're looking for somewhere to start, my gut tells me you should investigate northward. Additionally, I wonder if Liyue's Bishui River or the waters of Qingce Village have been affected...
There doesn't seem to be anything wrong with the water from Dragonspine or Springvale. The problem probably stems from Liyue.
Look, there was something inside it...
Endora... no water... dying...
Endora... Is that your name?
Bitterness... an enemy. It will kill... Endora.
Well, um, so what can we do to save you?
Need... sweet water. Must go to... spring.
Endora... need water to move. No water. Nowhere to go.
How are we going to get this thing to a spring?

dialogue.sit: Well, we've got a bottle right here.

dialogue.t: But it's bitter too, isn't it?
Endora... can endure. But... not for long.
Guess we can't afford to hang around, then. Let's get to a fresh spring, and quick!
Still, it's kinda interesting how Endora was able to make it this far off the back of a Hydro Slime. Kinda like our relationship, huh?
Water here... sweet. Endora finds... same species.
Endora and... same species, make the water sweet. Bitterness... Rhodeia's doing.
Same species? Oh, that's right, doesn't Springvale have a legend of a spring fairy or something?
But first things first, let's get rid of the bitter water from our bottle and refill it from the spring.
...Who are you?
Whoa, hang on a moment, Endora, you can't just run out by yourself like that!
I am Endora. I am a Lochfolk.
Wait, that's right! This guy is supposed to be one of the real believers in the spring fairy's existence.
...Mm-hmm.
You're the spitting image of her. Just a fair bit smaller.
Endora... still small! Endora... still learning.
Well, your appearance proves to me that she was real. It wasn't just a dream.
She is still here. Name... unknown. She will not answer Endora.
Endora... wants to talk to her. Can take a message. What do you want to say?
You're saying she's been here all this time? And you can give her a message for me?
Yes. Yes.
...Hmm.
I'm so old now, I...
...Tell her I said hello.
She said some... strange things. Endora does not understand.
The stream... hmm... I did not understand. Asked, received no reply.

dialogue.sit: Perhaps your vocabulary could use a little more breadth.

dialogue.t: Guess the spring fairy must have her reasons for not wanting to meet us.
I do not... understand. Lochfolk like to join together.
She is... one mind. All alone.
Maybe it's because other creatures can't fit in with you.
Oh? Why not?
Well, we'd drown for starters!
You are lonely... We love all... We love all people.
Ah!
Eh? What's going on?
Rhodeia's gaze... near the Stone Gate! Small water animals. Her scouts.
Water animals? We saw some Oceanid Creatures 'round here once, didn't we?
Powerful water... changes shape into animals. Very dangerous. But joining with them... we learn new things.
Take me there. Rhodeia is uneasy. Rhodeia... makes water bitter. Endora will learn to speak. Explain to her.

dialogue.sit: So you're saying that you can help us, then?

dialogue.t: Yes. Yes.
Well, {NICKNAME}, it's worth a shot. We don't have any other clues, anyway.
She is real, after all. But why does she no longer speak?
I have found something!
Whoa, you're speaking fluently all of a sudden!
My grasp of language has expanded from merging with those Oceanid Creatures. I can now comprehend the message from Springvale.
"The stream of life flows on." It's a little melancholic. A short but enigmatic poem. I don't understand it.

dialogue.sit: Maybe you'll figure it out in the future.

dialogue.t: Endora still has much to learn.
Rhodeia has been going wild lately. I must face her, and perhaps we can solve the problem that way.

quests.description: The water source near the winery has become bitter for no apparent reason. The Adventurers’ Guild hopes for your cooperation in resolving this matter.
